clip44.title: UPI fail, par paise kat gaye? RBI ka ye niyam jaano #Shorts
clip44.description:
UPI payment fail ho gaya par paise kat gaye? RBI ke niyam (20 Sep 2019 circular) ke hisaab se: paise bheje aur saamne wale ke account mein nahi gaye, toh auto-reversal max T+1 din (T = transaction ka din). Der hui toh bank ko ₹100 har din ka muaavza dena hota hai. Merchant/dukaan payment mein confirmation nahi mila toh T+5 din. Muaavza bina shikayat ke apne aap aana chahiye; na aaye toh pehle bank se shikayat, phir RBI Integrated Ombudsman. General jaankari hai, legal/financial advice nahi.

Sources:
- RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 (DPSS.CO.PD No.629/02.01.014/2019-20), 20 Sep 2019, "Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorised Payment Systems": https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=11693&Mode=0
- RBI FAQ page (same text): https://www.rbi.org.in/commonperson/English/Scripts/FAQs.aspx?Id=3074

clip45.title: Chaand ka hamesha ek hi chehra kyun dikhta hai? #Shorts
clip45.description:
Chaand ka peeche wala hissa hum kabhi kyun nahi dekhte? Kyunki chaand ko apni dhuri par ek chakkar lagane mein utna hi time lagta hai jitna Prithvi ka ek chakkar lagane mein: isse tidal locking kehte hain. Bahut pehle tidal forces ne chaand ka spin dheema kiya. Aur chaand har saal lagbhag 4 cm door ja raha hai.

clip46.title: Online fraud se bachne ki 4 baatein + 1930 helpline #Shorts
clip46.description:
Online fraud se bachne ke liye: 1) OTP, PIN, CVV kabhi kisi ko mat batao. 2) UPI PIN / QR scan sirf paise bhejne ke liye, lene ke liye nahi. 3) Anjaan UPI ID ki payment request approve mat karo. 4) Fraud ho jaye toh turant National Cybercrime Helpline 1930 pe call karo ya https://cybercrime.gov.in pe shikayat karo. Bonus: shaq wali call/SMS/WhatsApp ko Sanchar Saathi ke Chakshu pe report karo: https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/sfc/

Sources:
- Department of Financial Services, Govt. of India, cyber security / financial fraud page: https://financialservices.gov.in/beta/page/csft
- Kerala Police, National Cyber Crime Reporting Helpline 1930: https://ps.keralapolice.gov.in/ernakulamruralcyber-ps/notifications/National-Cyber-Crime-Reporting-Helpline-No-1930-3338
